pages.text: An ion of mass m and charge q, accelerated through V volts, moves at √(2qV/m); in a field B it bends on a circle of radius r = √(2mV/q)/B. The detector sits at 0.5 m: for each mass there is one field that puts it there.
$(thing)Set$(): Magnetic field, Accelerating voltage.$(br2)$(thing)Disturbance$(): Field ripple: B varies by ±0.1%·d.
$(thing)Limits$(): The field is beyond the magnet's range.$(br2)$(thing)Rate$(): More voltage, more ions a second.
